chapter_1.name: The Three-Legged Stool and Granite Shelf
chapter_1.allegory: Broken stool kicks into hearth; granite shelf keyed into bedrock holds sheepskin folios
chapter_1.codebase_subsystem: state/seats/ (ephemeral seat memory) vs memory/runs/verkle/ (immutable append-only ledger)
chapter_1.re_derivation_target: Seat failure must produce zero state mutation on the immutable historical chain

chapter_2.name: The Stonecutter's Quarry Marks
chapter_2.allegory: Limestone quarry tallies sounded with iron key against painted linen map; dry cistern beneath false door
chapter_2.codebase_subsystem: tools/bekko_cpu_retriever.py (zero-GPU static vector lookup) and LAW-061 (floor checks hash)
chapter_2.re_derivation_target: Representation is subordinate to physical ground hash; static dictionary yields O(1) truth

chapter_3.name: The Gallery of the Thirty-Six Copper Bells
chapter_3.allegory: Four messengers marching together clash bells and crack plaster; dividing measure across droplets cancels vibration
chapter_3.house_law: Wave 6 Steal: Kuramoto Harmonic Interleave (2*pi / N phase offsets)
chapter_3.re_derivation_target: Decentralized background crons interleave execution cadences to eliminate git index.lock contention

chapter_4.name: The Sluice of the Fifty Stones
chapter_4.allegory: Bronze gate resists all half-measures; at fiftieth stone trigger slips and opens with full river force
chapter_4.codebase_subsystem: tools/ultrasensitive_gate.py (Hill equation step switch, n=8.0, Kd=0.80)
chapter_4.house_law: Wave 6 Steal: Baker-Hilton 500 nM Ultrasensitive Step Switch
chapter_4.re_derivation_target: Agents must not dither on linear confidence scales; actions are strictly 0.0 or 1.0 force

chapter_5.name: The Mortise Cut in the Eastern Wing
chapter_5.allegory: Refusal to paint rot with black pitch or burn house down; crosscut saw severs mortise clean into gorge
chapter_5.house_law: Wave 7 Steal: Perelman Ricci Flow with Surgery
chapter_5.re_derivation_target: Prune corrupted branches at joint without rewriting monotonic historical spine

chapter_6.name: The Single Chute on the River Wall
chapter_6.allegory: Three clerks wrestling choke brass mouth; bench seating establishes FIFO hints into locked chest
chapter_6.house_law: Estate Law: Seats never run git; one writer owns index FIFO
chapter_6.re_derivation_target: Single writer owns mutation pipeline; seats drop declarative JSON commit hints

chapter_7.name: The Sundial and the Foundries Across the Water
chapter_7.allegory: Courier demands clock tower hour and blacksmith tongs; Miriam refuses nonexistent entities
chapter_7.house_law: LAW-064: PREMISE_SPAN_GROUNDING and Epistemic Calibration Tier 1
chapter_7.re_derivation_target: Mechanical rejection of ungrounded counterfactual premises; refusal over confabulation
